standard.descriptionFirstLine: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. An unset variable expands to an empty string, so guard variables in such paths with `${VAR:?}`. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way.

governed.descriptionFirstLine: Execute a bash command through this Member's confined terminal face and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh confined shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Every path the command names is admitted against the compiled read lane before the shell starts; a refused read returns no bytes and names the typed refusal code in its error.

notes: The standard preset is the PINNED host baseline; its rows are declarations, not a live mount, because the transient shell and the skills/compaction/subagent rows are host-provided.

The governed preset is a copy of those declarations minus the `declaration.removed` rows (tool-pwsh, and since PD-18 tool-web + workflow-ptc/tool-workflow); the only row whose RESOLVED definition differs at runtime is `bash` (route-C shadow onto the confined terminal face).

PD-18 FAIL-CLOSED SURFACE: web_fetch/web_search and workflow are REMOVED from the governed preset because they resolved to the host base services with zero a5sf facts. Their absence here is a measured capability regression, not a claimed fix; the standard preset still declares workflow-ptc/tool-workflow and tool-web, so the capability exists outside the governed preset.
Retained-but-idle: tool-jobs has no producer on the governed preset (the confined face cannot hand a command to the job registry).
